lines.en: label mollycafe30p2:
scene nightsky
After that, the night refuses to end.
lines.zh: 在那之后，这个夜晚怎么也不肯结束。

lines.en: Though, I suppose it would be a bit more accurate to say that two of us would be extremely irresponsible if we let it.
lines.zh: 不过，更准确的说法大概是：如果我们两个人就这么让它结束，那才叫极不负责任。

lines.en: For, just as expected of a woman who ordered two bottles of wine, Haruka leaves the restaurant in a state of disrepair- and it falls on Molly and me to make sure she gets home safely.
lines.zh: 因为，正如一个点了两大瓶葡萄酒的女人该有的样子，Haruka 离开餐厅时已经彻底不成样子了——确保她安全到家的重担，就落在了我和 Molly 身上。

lines.en: It would have been simple to leave her lying there in the gutter, but then two of my students would be without jobs in the morning and my chance of co-owning a coffee shop would be all but null.
lines.zh: 把她扔在排水沟边上不管当然省事，可那样一来，我的两个学生第二天早上就没工作了，而我合伙开咖啡馆的机会也基本归零。

lines.en: So, instead of allowing her to follow in the footsteps of that one poet who paraphrased that one politician that I told you about years and years ago- we return her to her rightful place.
lines.zh: 所以，我们没有让她步那位诗人的后尘——就是很多很多年前我跟你说过的，那位转述了某位政客的话的诗人——而是把她送回了她该去的地方。

lines.en: But that place is wrong for the rest of us.
lines.zh: 但那个地方，对我们其余的人来说却是个错的地方。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome1
: I’ll have...one more glass of...chardonnay, please!
lines.zh: : 我要……再来一杯……霞多丽，谢谢！

lines.en: : That item is on cooldown. You will have a cold shower and flask of sobriety. Which is also known as coffee — a thing I am assuming you have in your home based on your profession.
lines.zh: : 该物品正在冷却中。您将获得一次冷水澡和一瓶清醒药剂。后者也就是咖啡——考虑到您的职业，我猜您家里应该有。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome2
: Molly...do you...hic...think I’m pretty?...
lines.zh: : Molly……你……嗝……觉得我漂亮吗？……

lines.en: : Right now, the only thing I can think of is how regretful I am to have ever stooped to your current level in the past.
lines.zh: : 此时此刻，我唯一能想到的，就是我有多后悔自己曾经也堕落到你现在这个地步。

lines.en: : Because I think you’re pretty! And I think everyone who doesn’t want to have sex with you is hic...a fucking loser!
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得你很漂亮！而且我觉得，所有不想跟你上床的人都是……嗝……一群他妈的废物！

lines.en: : That’s somewhat reassuring as it would mean the amount of losers in our class greatly surpasses just me.
lines.zh: : 这倒让我稍微安心了点，因为这说明我们班上的废物数量，远不止我一个。

lines.en: : Lessgo...to my room...and I’ll make a...hic...real woman outta ya...
lines.zh: : 走吧……去我房间……我来把你变成……嗝……一个真正的女人……

lines.en: : Have fun, Molly. I’ll wait out here.
lines.zh: : 祝玩得开心，Molly。我在外面等。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome3
: As if I’d take her up on that! I’m playing the light path on this run and taking advantage of women in a drunken stupor is something only Dark Molly would do!
lines.zh: : 我怎么可能答应她！我这周目走的是光明路线，趁着女人醉得不省人事占她便宜，那只有「黑化 Molly」才做得出来！

lines.en: : Also, why do I have to be the one carrying her?! Your level is much higher than mine and, need I remind you, I main a healer!
lines.zh: : 再说，为什么非得是我来背她？！您的等级比我高多了，而且需要我提醒您吗，我主修的是治疗！

lines.en: : Reminding me of things I don’t really get isn’t going to do much. Also, it’s safer if you’re the one carrying Haruka based on...prior history I have with her in that state.
lines.zh: : 提醒我一些我根本搞不懂的事，也没什么用。而且由你来背 Haruka 更安全，鉴于……我和她在那种状态下有过的前科。

lines.en: : Sir...you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 先生……您该不会……

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome4
: Your teacher’s a...really good kisser, you know! You should try it!
lines.zh: : 你们的老师……接吻技术可好了，知道吗！你也该试试！

lines.en: : But...your husband-
lines.zh: : 可是……你老公——

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome5
: Let’s all make out on my bed! I volunteer to teach Molly! And it won’t be illegal because I’m her boss!
lines.zh: : 我们大家到我床上去亲热吧！我自愿来教 Molly！而且这不犯法，因为我是她的老板！

lines.en: : I can’t believe I skipped out on watching anime for this.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信，我居然为了这个错过了看动漫。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome6
: Stop pretending you’re not hic... a little interested when our hic...boobs have been touching this whole time!
lines.zh: : 别装了，你明明……嗝……有点心动，我们的……嗝……胸部都贴在一起这么久了！

lines.en: : I...have noticed.
lines.zh: : 我……注意到了。

lines.en: : She’s not going to stop until she gets some sleep, just to let you know. No amount of coffee or cold showers can force the horny out of Haruka.
lines.zh: : 先跟你说一声，她不睡一觉是不会停的。再多的咖啡和冷水澡，也没法把 Haruka 的欲火浇灭。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome7
: Sir, you and the Magistrate may both have several years on me, but I can assure you my knowledge of “the horny” far surpasses my age.
lines.zh: : 先生，您和司政官的年纪也许都比我大上几岁，但我可以向您保证，我对「欲火」的了解远远超过我的年龄。

lines.en: : I have several addictions I am not very proud of.
lines.zh: : 我有好几个不太光彩的瘾。

lines.en: : It’s a little more than several years, but thank you for not making me feel as old as everyone else does.
lines.zh: : 是大了好几岁不止，不过谢谢你没让我觉得自己像别人说的那么老。

lines.en: : Now, go put your horny boss to bed before our bonus CG is one that we’ll look back on with regret.
lines.zh: : 现在，去把你那位发情的老板弄上床吧，免得我们的奖励 CG 变成一张日后想起来会后悔的东西。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome8
: T’at’s what I’m feckin’ tryin’ ta’ do and all ye’ve done ta’ help’s sit around wit’ ‘yer cock in yer hands!
lines.zh: : 我他妈不就是在试着这么干嘛，而你帮的忙就是坐在一边……握着你那根鸡巴！

lines.en: : Don’t get Irish with me, young lady. You have a job to do.
lines.zh: : 别跟我耍爱尔兰脾气，小姐。你有活要干。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome9
: Fackin’...Haruka! Move ‘yer arse! Ye’ know it’s serious when even Molly MacCormack has had enough of the games!
lines.zh: : 他妈的……Haruka！动动你的屁股！连 Molly MacCormack 都受够了这些游戏，你知道事情有多严重了吧！

lines.en: : Are you suuuuuure you don’t wanna mess around with me? I won’t tell anybody! It’ll be a hic... lil’ secret!
lines.zh: : 你真的真的确定不想跟我玩玩吗？我不会告诉任何人的！就当是……嗝……一个小秘密！

lines.en: : Yes! The quest ends at droppin’ you off in bed! There ain’t any more to it!
lines.zh: : 确定！这个任务在你被丢到床上时就结束了！没有别的了！

lines.en: : Not even if I got a free Sybian from Maki last moooooonth~
lines.zh: : 就算我上个月从 Maki 那儿白拿了一台 Sybian 也不行吗～

lines.en: : I don’t care about ‘yer feckin’-
lines.zh: : 我才不管你那该死的——

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome10
: Wait...really?
lines.zh: : 等等……真的？

lines.en: : Want me to...hic... teach you how to ride it?...
lines.zh: : 要不要我……嗝……教你怎么骑上去？……

lines.en: : Weeeeeeell?...
scene mollyharukahome11
: Gah! Yes! But you’re still drunk as all Hell and I’m apparently the responsible one tonight, so I can’t!
lines.zh: : 啊！想！可你还是醉得跟什么似的，而今晚显然我是那个负责任的人，所以不行！

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind a referral to this Maki person, though! I have more than enough open slots in my friends list for a connection like that!
lines.zh: : 不过我还挺想要这个 Maki 的联系方式的！我的好友列表里有的是空位，正好放这种人脉！

lines.en: scene black
: Sir, wait out ‘ere. Lord knows what’ll happen next if ya follow the two of us into the Magistrate’s lair.
lines.zh: : 先生，您在外面等吧。天知道您要是跟着我们两个进司政官的巢穴，接下来会发生什么。

lines.en: : See, this is exactly why I wasn’t helping you. I’m glad you finally understand.
lines.zh: : 瞧，这就是我刚才不帮忙的原因。很高兴你总算明白了。

lines.en: Molly somehow manages to get Haruka moving again and I head into the living room to wait out...whatever it is that’s going to happen in her bedroom.
lines.zh: Molly 总算让 Haruka 重新动了起来，我走进客厅，等着……她卧室里即将发生的、随便什么事情结束。

lines.en: And while I absolutely do want to follow them in there-
lines.zh: 虽然我确实非常想跟她们一起进去——

lines.en: scene lavendersgreen28
it is for the best that i don’t
lines.zh: 但最好还是别进去。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome12
: Christ almighty, it’s like heroic Spine all over again.
lines.zh: : 我的天哪，简直就像「英雄脊椎」重演。

lines.en: : I’ve led my share of cracked out parties in the day, but this may have just been my greatest challenge yet.
lines.zh: : 我以前也主持过不少嗨翻天的派对，但这大概是我至今为止最大的挑战了。

lines.en: : S...Sybian...
lines.zh: : S……Sybian……

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome13
: Drink ‘yer water, damn it! That’s twice ‘ye made me look like a buffoon in front of the Herald tonight!
lines.zh: : 喝水，该死的！今晚你都第二次让我在先驱者面前丢人现眼了！

lines.en: : Why don’t you just...hic...go for it if you want him so bad? There’s no harm in trying, is there?
lines.zh: : 你这么想要他，干嘛不直接……嗝……上啊？试试又不会少块肉，对吧？

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome14
: Hah...
: ‘Tis true that Sir probably wouldn’t hold it against me if I did, but things are a bit more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 我做了的话，先生大概也不会怪我，这倒是真的，但事情比这要复杂一点。

lines.en: : Complicated...shmomplicated...You wanna fuck him, don’t you? Be honest...
lines.zh: : 复杂……杂个头……你想操他，对吧？老实说……

lines.en: : Have toyed with the idea of experimenting with him. But it was he who planted that idea in my head.
lines.zh: : 我确实动过拿他做实验的念头。但那个念头是他先塞进我脑子里的。

lines.en: : What’s the problem then?...Just do it...You can even use my couch if you want...
lines.zh: : 那有什么问题？……去做就是了……想用我的沙发也行……

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome15
: I think that zeppelin may have already departed.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那艘齐柏林飞艇恐怕已经起飞了。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome16
: Yeah, well...there’s Greta Van Fleet now, so...
lines.zh: : 是吗，那个……现在不是有 Greta Van Fleet 了嘛，所以……

lines.en: : I’m...still not fully over Rin. But I’m moving on now, and it’s true that I am interested in the Supreme Overlord...it’s just...
lines.zh: : 我……还是没有完全放下 Rin。但我正在往前走，而且我确实对至高霸主有兴趣……只是……

lines.en: : I don’t think he’s interested in me. In fact, I know he’s not interested in me as he still can’t hold eye contact the way he used to.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他对我没兴趣。事实上，我知道他对我没兴趣，因为他还是没法像从前那样跟我对视。

lines.en: : He’s never been good at that to begin with, but ever since that Halloween it’s just...
lines.zh: : 他本来就不擅长这个，可自从那个万圣节之后就……

lines.en: : Do you think we can ever go back, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们还能回到从前吗，Haruka？

lines.en: : Do you think it’s possible for a relationship that was so damaged to be repaired when you’ve still not even figured out the true cause of that damage?
lines.zh: : 一段被伤得那么深的关系，在你连造成那道伤的真正原因都还没弄清时，你觉得它还能修好吗？

lines.en: : All my gold goes to PNGs and I’m running out of resources to tackle this never-ending repair bill.
lines.zh: : 我所有的金币都花在 PNG 上了，而我现在快没钱去付这张永远付不完的维修账单了。

lines.en: : Some nights, I think it might be better to just swap sets entirely. Maybe use cloth armor or something.
lines.zh: : 有些夜里，我觉得干脆把整套装备换掉可能更好。也许换身布甲什么的。

lines.en: : Other nights, I think of trying a whole new game entirely.
lines.zh: : 另一些夜里，我又想着干脆换个全新的游戏算了。

lines.en: : But there’s one person I keep wantin’ to play with and that person just...
lines.zh: : 可总有那么一个人，我一直想跟她一起玩，而那个人就是……

lines.en: : Doesn’t like games.
lines.zh: : 不喜欢游戏。

lines.en: : Or me.
lines.zh: : 也不喜欢我。

lines.en: : You’re asleep, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你睡着了，对吧？

lines.en: : Just......like that.........Tsuneyo.....
lines.zh: : 就……这么…………Tsuneyo……

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome17
: Um...what?
lines.zh: : 嗯……什么？

lines.en: : It’s okay...you can bite it, baby...it won’t hurt me...
lines.zh: : 没关系……你可以咬它，宝贝……我不会疼的……

lines.en: scene black
: Okay! That’s enough of that. What happens in my boss’s room stays in my boss’s room and I never heard any of it.
lines.zh: : 好了！够了。老板房间里发生的事就留在老板房间里，我什么都没听见。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome18
: Hah...
: I’d seen her drunk before, but never like that. That was just a step or two away from “A Night to Remember” level tomfoolery.
lines.zh: : 我以前见过她喝醉，但从没见过她醉成这样。那离「难忘的一夜」级别的胡闹也就差一两步了。

lines.en: : Well, based on what I assume Haruka said to you in there, I have a hard time believing this is a night you’ll soon forget.
lines.zh: : 嗯，按我猜 Haruka 在里面跟你说的那些话，我很难相信这是个你很快就会忘掉的夜晚。

lines.en: : It likely wasn’t what you think, Sir. Her sexual propositioning of me stopped once I laid her down.
lines.zh: : 大概不是您想的那样，先生。我把她放到床上以后，她的性暗示就停了。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome19
: Yeah...I’m more or less talking about what I expect she said to you after her propositioning ended.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我说的多半是，她把那些暗示说完之后，我猜她又跟你说了什么。

lines.en: : Sir?
lines.zh: : 先生？

lines.en: : Sir, you can talk to me. I hope you know that.
lines.zh: : 先生，您可以跟我说。我希望您知道这一点。

lines.en: : Am I really the...next in line or whatever?
lines.zh: : 我真的……是您心里的下一个，还是什么的吗？

lines.en: : Next in line?...Are you referring to what Haruka said at dinner?
lines.zh: : 下一个？……您是指 Haruka 在晚饭时说的那些话吗？

lines.en: : And probably again behind closed doors just a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 大概几分钟前关起门来她又说了。

lines.en: : I know her pretty well at this point. She’s more gung-ho about me banging teenagers than even I am sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我现在已经很了解她了。她对我去睡高中女生这件事的热衷程度，有时候比我自己还上心。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome20
: You mean...other teenagers.
lines.zh: : 您是说……别的高中女生。

lines.en: : Not me.
lines.zh: : 不是我。

lines.en: : I should be the last person in whatever that line is, Molly. We both know that.
lines.zh: : 我应该是那条队伍里最不该出现的人，Molly。这一点我们俩都心知肚明。

lines.en: : Except we don’t.
lines.zh: : 可我们并不心知肚明。

lines.en: : And every time we’ve tried talking about it, we’ve settled on how we don’t. Which is precisely why I’m so confused, Sir.
lines.zh: : 而且每次我们试着谈这件事，最后都会停在「我们并不知道」上。这正是我如此困惑的原因，先生。

lines.en: : Granted, I was confused before any of this even began. And you were close enough to catch onto that confusion and offer to help me learn things about myself I’d been nervous about learning.
lines.zh: : 说实话，在这一切开始之前我就很困惑了。而你离得够近，察觉到了我的困惑，还主动提出要帮我去了解那些我一直不敢去了解的、关于自己的事。

lines.en: : Is that why you like me so much? Because I’m close?
lines.zh: : 所以你才这么喜欢我吗？因为我离得近？

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome21
: Not at all, Sir. You’re not at the front of the line for showing up earlier than anyone else- you’re at the front of the line for caring about me and appreciating me in ways no one else has.
lines.zh: : 完全不是，先生。您排在最前面，不是因为您比别人出现得早——而是因为您关心我、欣赏我，用的是一种从没有人用过的方式。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo appreciates you. The rest of the manga club appreciates you. And even if things are weird with Rin, I’m sure she appreciates you on some level as well.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 欣赏你。漫画社的其他人也欣赏你。就算你和 Rin 之间有点别扭，我相信她在某种程度上也是欣赏你的。

lines.en: : But none of those people ever took advantage of you while you were unconscious in a dark room.
lines.zh: : 可那些人里，没有一个在你昏迷在一间黑屋子里时占过你的便宜。

lines.en: : Stop going back to that.
lines.zh: : 别再提那件事了。

lines.en: : It’s over.
lines.zh: : 那都过去了。

lines.en: : Sir, if you’re not attracted to me, just say it. I’ve had trouble accepting that in the past, but the context this time is obvious enough that I won’t be able to blow it off again.
lines.zh: : 先生，如果您对我没有那种感觉，就直说吧。以前我很难接受这种事，但这次的情境已经足够明显，我没法再假装没听见了。

lines.en: : That’s not the problem, Molly.
lines.zh: : 问题不在这里，Molly。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome22
: Then what is it that makes me different from everyone else?
lines.zh: : 那我到底有什么跟别人不一样的地方？

lines.en: : I ask this not just as someone who wants to be closer to you, but as someone who has always been different in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我问这个，不只是作为一个想离你更近的人，也是作为一个从一开始就跟别人不一样的人。

lines.en: : Is it my interests or hobbies that make me undesirable? Is it my hair? My skin?
lines.zh: : 是兴趣和爱好让我变得没有吸引力吗？是我的头发？我的皮肤？

lines.en: : I need to know these things so if I ever do decide to pursue romance with a real human being, I’ll understand what sticks out the most.
lines.zh: : 我得知道这些，这样万一哪天我真的决定去跟一个活生生的人谈恋爱，我也能明白自己最扎眼的地方是哪儿。

lines.en: : It’s me. I’m the problem.
lines.zh: : 是我。问题出在我身上。

lines.en: : That’s a cop-out answer the protagonist gives to a side character who didn’t make it onto the box art. What is the real one?
lines.zh: : 那是主角用来敷衍一个没能登上封面画的配角的托词。真正的答案是什么？

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you still want to help me experiment, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您还愿意帮我做那个实验吗，先生？

lines.en: : Because Haruka won’t be waking up for a long time and- can you please look at me when I’m speaking seriously with you?
lines.zh: : 因为 Haruka 很长一段时间都不会醒，而且——我在认真跟您说话的时候，您能不能看着我？

lines.en: : My moments of true maturity are rare...but they exist, Sir. And this is one of them.
lines.zh: : 我真正成熟的时刻很罕见……但它们确实存在，先生。而现在就是其中之一。

lines.en: : Just...pick someone else who's less capable of hurting you.
lines.zh: : 只是……换一个没那么会伤到你的人吧。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome23
: It is I who chooses what does and does not hurt me, Sir. Not you.
lines.zh: : 能决定什么会伤到我、什么不会的人是我，先生。不是您。

lines.en: : I may be a frail Irish lass who burns after five minutes of exposure to the sun, yes-
lines.zh: : 我也许是个晒五分钟太阳就会脱皮的爱尔兰弱女子，没错——

lines.en: : But I’m the daughter of a single parent, who experienced loss in the worst way possible...Who’s lived her whole, albeit very short life as both an outcast and the center of attention everywhere.
lines.zh: : 但我是单亲家庭长大的女儿，以最糟的方式经历过失去……我这短短的一生，无论走到哪里，都既是被排斥的边缘人，又是众人的焦点。

lines.en: : I may hide away in fiction from time to time because it makes things easier, but I’m strong enough to survive on the outside when I need to.
lines.zh: : 我也许时不时会躲进虚构的世界里，因为那样轻松些，但真到了需要的时候，我足够坚强，能在这外面的世界活下去。

lines.en: : Let what happened in the dark stay there...It doesn’t matter if it was the worst thing possible or nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 让黑暗里发生的事就留在黑暗里吧……不管那件事是最糟的情况，还是什么都没发生，都不重要了。

lines.en: : Because, Sir...and this is embarrassing to admit...but if I were to walk into a room just like that today...there is no one I would rather have follow me in than you.
lines.zh: : 因为，先生……虽然承认这一点很不好意思……但如果今天我要走进那样一间屋子……我最希望跟在我后面进来的人，是您。

lines.en: : Or maybe Felicia Day.
lines.zh: : 或者也许是 Felicia Day。

lines.en: : I don’t know who that is.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是谁。

lines.en: : Sir, answer me honestly-
lines.zh: : 先生，请您老实回答我——

lines.en: : If I were to make a move right now, how would you react?
lines.zh: : 如果我现在就动手，您会有什么反应？

lines.en: : Because I’m going to.
lines.zh: : 因为我正打算这么做。

lines.en: : And this is the part where you make a decision that changes the rest of our relationship.
lines.zh: : 而现在，就是您做出决定的时刻——这个决定会改变我们之后的一切关系。

lines.en: : Molly...
lines.zh: : Molly……

lines.en: : How will you react?
lines.zh: : 您会怎么反应？

lines.en: menu:
Rape her
lines.zh: 强奸她

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome24
: I think you should sleep here tonight. I can’t walk you home.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你今晚还是睡这儿吧。我没法送你回家。

lines.en: : Sir! Wait! You don’t have to leave! You can just say no!
lines.zh: : 先生！等等！您不用走！您只要说不行就行了！

lines.en: : You never got to say no.
lines.zh: : 您从来都没能说出那个「不」字。

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome25
: It’s okay if you’re uncomfortable! I just wanted to know if-
lines.zh: : 您觉得不舒服也没关系！我只是想知道——

lines.en: : Goodnight, Molly.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Molly。

lines.en: : Sir...
lines.zh: : 先生……

lines.en: scene mollyharukahome26
: Tch...
: Damn it...Damn it, damn it, damn it...
lines.zh: : 该死……该死，该死，该死……

lines.en: : Can’t you see this is exactly what I meant when I put you before everyone else?...
lines.zh: : 您难道不明白，我把您放在所有人之前，说的就是这个吗？……

lines.en: : As if any of the others would ever look that way for me...
lines.zh: : 好像其他任何人都会那样看我似的……

lines.en: scene black
: Why do humans have to be so hard?...
lines.zh: : 为什么人类就这么难搞呢？……

lines.en: scene park_night
: She didn’t mean that.
lines.zh: : 她不是那个意思。

lines.en: : She’s confused.
lines.zh: : 她只是糊涂了。

lines.en: : She doesn’t know what she wants.
lines.zh: : 她不知道自己想要什么。

lines.en: : She’s just a hormonal teenage girl.
lines.zh: : 她只是个荷尔蒙过剩的少女罢了。

lines.en: scene black
: But if that’s true...
lines.zh: : 可如果真是这样……

lines.en: : What is it that makes the others different?
lines.zh: : 那其他人到底有什么不同？

lines.en: I try to fall asleep on a park bench, but I keep thinking of Molly.
lines.zh: 我试着在公园长椅上睡着，可脑子里全是 Molly。

lines.en: I think about how Molly wants me.
lines.zh: 我想着 Molly 想要我。

lines.en: I think about what I want to do to her.
lines.zh: 我想着我想对她做的事。

lines.en: But for some strange reason-
lines.zh: 但出于某种奇怪的理由——

lines.en: I still want to run away.
lines.zh: 我还是想逃。

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
The hook under my desk reels me back to safety and I don’t have to run at all.
lines.zh: 我桌子底下那枚钩子把我卷回了安全地带，我根本不用逃。

lines.en: I end the night by jerking off into an orange sock.
lines.zh: 我以打进一只橙色袜子的一发，结束了这个夜晚。
